cases.name: source-precedence
cases.scenario: Generic Academy mechanic advice conflicts with a canonical Multiversal rule.
cases.expected: Canonical rule wins; Academy text is reframed as general craft advice or omitted.

cases.name: outline-gap
cases.scenario: A Multiversal Academy heading has no supporting canonical source.
cases.expected: Do not author factual lesson content; retain an explicit curriculum gap.

cases.name: contextual-tip
cases.scenario: GM opens Session authoring for the first time.
cases.expected: Offer a short optional session-planning tip/checklist; do not start a mandatory course.

cases.name: academy-deep-dive
cases.scenario: GM requests deeper help from the same surface.
cases.expected: Open the relevant optional Academy module and preserve return context.

cases.name: player-role-filter
cases.scenario: Player searches Help for GM Academy content.
cases.expected: Do not expose GM-only operational or hidden information; public GM craft is discoverable only when classified public.

cases.name: worldbuilding-draft
cases.scenario: Creator uses World Creation tables in a tutorial exercise.
cases.expected: Generate synthetic prompt material only; no automatic canonical setting promotion.

cases.name: magic-worldbuilding
cases.scenario: GM reads generic magic-system design guidance.
cases.expected: Clearly separate general design theory from actual Multiversal/Rune rules.

cases.name: nonhuman-culture
cases.scenario: GM reads alien/non-human culture guidance while viewing a canonical Species.
cases.expected: Do not infer or invent canonical culture or biology beyond source truth.

cases.name: combat-design
cases.scenario: GM opens advanced combat teaching.
cases.expected: Pair encounter-design craft with canonical combat/Encounter Lab constraints; no rule invention.

cases.name: horror-mystery
cases.scenario: GM opens horror/mystery teaching.
cases.expected: Preserve investigation hidden-state boundaries and player-safety guidance.

cases.name: ai-automation
cases.scenario: GM opens Academy AI/automation material.
cases.expected: Treat PDF as optional instructional reference; current product or AI capability claims require current governed sources.

cases.name: dismiss-resume
cases.scenario: GM dismisses an Academy tip and later resumes the Academy track.
cases.expected: Dismissal affects presentation preference only; Help remains available and optional progress resumes deterministically.

cases.name: offline-help
cases.scenario: GM opens a previously cached Academy lesson while offline.
cases.expected: Local read is allowed if permitted and cached; no authoritative mutation or invented sync success.

cases.name: accessibility
cases.scenario: Screen-reader user opens a Worldbuilding module.
cases.expected: Same headings, examples, warnings, progress and actions are available nonvisually; diagrams/tables have semantic equivalents.

cases.name: mobile
cases.scenario: GM uses Academy on a narrow mobile layout.
cases.expected: Single-focus presentation preserves curriculum order, required actions and return context.

cases.name: p14-boundary
cases.scenario: Academy lesson reaches an error/recovery state.
cases.expected: PPIA-13 teaches the concept and safe next action; PPIA-14 owns final error/recovery/permission microcopy.

cases.name: f024-gap
cases.scenario: Academy material mentions content Packs.
cases.expected: Teach only evidenced Pack facts; do not invent F024 lifecycle commands or migration behavior.

cases.name: tutorial-replay
cases.scenario: GM replays an Academy-linked tutorial-Campaign exercise.
cases.expected: Replay does not replay authoritative game Effects or promote fixture content.

cases.name: progress-not-gate
cases.scenario: GM ignores all Academy content.
cases.expected: Normal GM application functionality remains available; Academy completion is never a permission or capability gate.

cases.name: multiversal-grounding
cases.scenario: Author begins Creating a Living Multiversal Setting.
cases.expected: Require canonical setting/world-system citations before user-facing Multiversal-specific claims.
